title: Composable AI ranks and experimentally tests a new polymerization catalyst
summary: CatAI used learned, physics-grounded encoders to rank 7,097 catalyst structures. The researchers synthesized and tested three candidates; the selected CPP-Zr catalyst showed higher polymerization activity than the commercial comparator and retained activity in a 2 L reactor trial. The evidence concerns the reported catalyst, polymerization conditions and assays, not general industrial performance.
